_about: How each training report's company is written in its own text, for figure_augment's company swap. Matched case-insensitively, longest first; a form ending in Limited or Ltd becomes the new company's registered name, any other its short name. Bare 'Bajaj' and 'HDFC' are left out on purpose: they also name sister companies.

Power Grid Corporation of India Limited: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
